signals.label: NEAR_CRITICAL_MASS

threshold_applied.expression: reserves_usdc >= 0.90 * 5042000000 (i.e. 90% of the 5,042 USDC ignition threshold)

signals.limitations: The 90% figure is illustrative and has not been agreed. Distance to threshold is not a statement about whether the remaining distance will be covered.

signals.label: BUY_PRESSURE
signals.limitations: Directional volume ratio is manipulable by a participant willing to trade against themselves; the window length materially changes the result and has not been agreed.

signals.label: HIGH_HOLDER_CONCENTRATION

threshold_applied.expression: sum(top_10_holder_balances) / circulating_supply >= 0.50, excluding the reaction contract

signals.limitations: Address count is not holder count. Concentration measured across addresses says nothing about how many distinct parties hold. Exclusion set is incomplete: routers and custodial addresses are not yet classified.

notes: ILLUSTRATIVE AND NON-NORMATIVE. Every threshold expression in this snapshot carries status 'unresolved': the 90%, 0.70 and 0.50 figures are placeholders used to exercise the schema, not agreed cutoffs. Block heights, balances and volumes are invented. The only figure here that is a protocol fact is the 5,042 USDC ignition threshold. Illustrative only. Not protocol defaults or committed parameters.
